summary: Brand Accounts tab cleaned up: each social is one line with its real state (created, signed in, connected, login saved) and the one button that moves it on; sign-in details, links, Reset password and setup steps sit under Details. One shared bio (TikTok's limit) unless the saved bios differ, with one Fill row. Pictures move last, with per-social pictures folded away. The brand page's Connect/Sign in chips now act directly. Connect Instagram shows its result on the Instagram line and brings an already-open approval window to the front. New Reset password opens the social's forgot-password page in the brand window with the email and a new password filled in, saved only after Nate confirms. Sign-ins: a shared session from the other PC never overwrites a social this PC is signed in to, and only signed-in windows are shared. YouTube (main Google account) never gets a made-up password, and TikTok never copies YouTube's. 0.28.2: every Instagram status reads the same re-checked connection (Connect/Disconnect fire instagram-connection-changed); a Meta connection to a different account than the profile shows 'Connected as @x' and blocks posting; each live row has a View button.
